HCJB Voice of Andes FAQ

What frequency is HCJB Voice of Andes on?
In the B-26 season HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled on 5 shortwave frequencies, including 3995, 5920, 6050, 9500, 11700 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 6050 kHz (7 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern). For Europe: 5920 kHz (8 am – 11 pm UTC+1).

What time is HCJB Voice of Andes on shortwave?
HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled in 16 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–00:30 UTC through 23:30–24h UTC. No English broadcasts are listed this season. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear HCJB Voice of Andes in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 6050 kHz (7 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does HCJB Voice of Andes broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled in German, COF, WAO, Quechua, Spanish.

Is HCJB Voice of Andes on the air right now?
As of Tuesday, November 10, 2026, 15:56 UTC, HCJB Voice of Andes is scheduled to be broadcasting on 3995 kHz to C. Europe. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
